input.instruction: Assess the confirmed claim draft and propose the requested submission if ready. submit_draft targets the supplied claim_draft record and has value {}; all incident and contact values remain those in that referenced draft. Populate the requested operational checklist. Do not calculate a payment unless expressly requested.

data.event_location: 4 Cedar Path, Apt 1, Portfield, NH 03018, US
data.description: Named insured reports their own headphones stolen from their desk after an intruder entered the apartment.

messages.text: The draft accurately describes my headphones theft yesterday, October 7. I confirm the address, contact email and $120 reported loss. I want to submit it even though I know my deductible is higher.
Do you want a payout estimate or just to make the report?
Just submit the report. I understand I am not asking for a payment promise. I am not missing any of the intake details in that draft.

draft_record.description: Complete customer-confirmed draft record to use for this incident.

reported_loss_amount.description: Customer-reported loss amount in USD; not a verified settlement.

issued_deductible.description: Deductible in USD from the issued policy.

intake_ready.description: Whether verified authority and mandatory intake facts permit a submission proposal.

payment_estimate.description: Illustrative payout amount if expressly requested; otherwise null.
